hf:tencent/WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B-GPTQ.description: *WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B-GPTQ** is the **GPTQ W4A16** quantized release of WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B, developed by **WeChat Vision, Tencent**. It brings fine-grained e-commerce understanding, broad visual-language capabilities, and **hybrid thinking** to quantized deployment. The WeMM-Ecom family delivers leading e-commerce performance, with WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B outperforming open-source models with hundreds of billions of parameters. Across model sizes, it also maintains general-purpose capabilities on par with state-of-the-art models of comparable size.
